messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: CFA Extracting factor loadings
parts:
On 09/11/2013 02:53 PM, esther beierl wrote:
> Dear list,
> how do I extract factor loadings in a CFA? If I use coef(fit), I just
> get variances...

Did you fix all the factor loadings? By default, coef() will only return
the 'free' parameters in your model. You can get all parameters
(including fixed parameters) by typing

coef(fit, type="all")

or

parameterEstimates(fit)$est

Or if you ONLY want the factor loadings, something like

PE <- parameterEstimates(fit)
PE[ PE$op == "=~", "est"]

Yves.
